transcript.text: Stop! A little warning before you watch this. These jury sets come with a serious allegation of wanting more unexpected compliments, endless outfit planning and a sudden urge to own them all. Ever since I got married, it's been one function after another and every occasion comes with a new reason to shop. I told myself at the little break, but then, Giva's Black Friday sale is here up to 30% of starting 25th November. I mean, can you blame me? So don't say I didn't want you. Go find your favourite set at Giva.
